authorityBasis: Direct repository-owner delegation on 2026-10-22 to decide all appropriate owner, implementation, architecture, setup and configuration approvals for Media and Lifecycle, without repeated approval round trips; does not confer independent reviewer or cryptographic verifier status.
approvedDecisions: Adopt the existing Lifecycle gtool and Evidence Contracts / Verification Planner / Evidence Generator / Surface Convergence as single native closure mechanism.
Keep Media PDP-0..3 current source definitions and 54-row matrices authoritative; do not reopen for missing independent closure.
Approve the implementation and configuration work for AP-02/AP-03 admission, Media topology and exact case/proof maps on main after current-source verification.
Approve incremental physical-leaf closure first, then meaningful compositions and root; preserve N/A/archive/unknown distinctions.
Permit eligible BUILD implementation in parallel rather than imposing native closure as a BUILD entry blocker.
Maintain Media consumer providerBindings empty; proof production belongs to canonical Evidence Generator owner.
Reuse existing owner-permitted records and current evidence without rerunning unaffected expensive operations.
requiresActualIndependentAuthority: AP-02 exact contract DAG distribution selection and trusted verifier registration
AP-03 exact owner-selected current snapshot and trusted Planner verifier registration
Admitted exact source-to-surface/obligation/case memberships and authentic proof routes
Evidence Generator-native executed proof, independent oracle/reviewer approval, durable canonical receipt
Same-owner currentness and revocation readback before CLOSED/CURRENT
prohibited: Self-issued test fixture as canonical owner verifier
Mass default N/A or automatic semantic case guessing
Aggregate native closure without child proof

approvedOwnerDecisions.campaign: Retain all 54 Media source identities with four PDP phases, preserve explicit N/A, support-only, archived and no-runtime-admitted classifications; do not equate source identities to native ClosureSurfaces.
approvedOwnerDecisions.sourceDefinition: Accept the current source-defined PDP status and previously recorded owner dispositions for unchanged current source; re-open only a proven material source meaning change, never for missing Build or closure receipts.
approvedOwnerDecisions.caseCoverage: Authorize exact source-ID-based reusable deterministic case/proof selectors and semantic-grouped tests, provided each obligation has an individually reviewable assertion or explicit uncovered blocker. No one-test-per-obligation rule; never auto-adopt a case solely from naming similarity.
approvedOwnerDecisions.closureBoundary: Own independent physical leaf proof at actual execution boundaries, one shared runtime implementation may serve multiple logical consumer contracts; semantic compositions hold only direct cross-child obligations and dependencies, not copied leaf obligations.
approvedOwnerDecisions.proofPartition: Product-definition acceptance proves authored semantic truth, source traceability, negative cases, interface/experience specifications and Explorer where applicable. BUILD runtime behavior is separately tested. Do not make unimplemented product runtime a PDP source-definition closure prerequisite absent an explicit policy.
approvedOwnerDecisions.evidence: One canonical Evidence Generator proof producer. A source-pinned real computation may be reused across unaffected obligations/units only when canonical planner and receipt identities permit; do not fabricate an independent witness.
approvedOwnerDecisions.recording: PDP-3 source-owned narrated Explorer capture and its review form a source definition acceptance requirement where adopted; actual Build product capture with semantic-equivalence is a separate later real-behavior requirement. Start first real business-outcome recording once qualified end-to-end flow is present.
approvedOwnerDecisions.scheduler: AP-02 distribution, AP-03 snapshot, PDP-0 surface/case mapping, and eligible Build packages proceed in parallel with disjoint writers. Native leaf closure follows actual authenticated admission; composite/root require their declared children.
approvedOwnerDecisions.buildEligibility: Calculate Build entry independently for each exact source-bound physical or composite unit. A unit is eligible only when every applicable PDP-0..3 definition for that unit is current, validated DEV_COMPLETE with a known zero phase-local task inventory, and every explicitly declared predecessor and dependency obligation for that unit passes. Missing, stale, contradictory, partial, or unknown inputs block only the affected unit and its declared dependents. Keep the complete 54-identity campaign denominator and aggregate Discovery result visible; neither aggregate FAIL/UNKNOWN nor an unrelated incomplete surface is a global Build lock. Composite and root implementation/integration require their declared child/dependency obligations. Package-specific Build prerequisites, owner/resource authorization, verification, Development Complete, and all independent PDP-closure, Delivery, and release gates remain in force.
approvedOwnerDecisions.ownerRoles: Architecture, product, implementation, review of non-specialist source decisions, scope, N/A classifications supported by source, migration-planning and test-selection decisions are delegated to implementation coordinator. No further discretionary approval prompt required within this bounded version.
approvedOwnerDecisions.trust: All independent specialist or verifier decisions require authenticated source-backed separate mechanisms and remain verified by their real owner paths. Owner delegation never becomes a signature or native receipt.
